applicabilityBasis.summary: Maple expressly describes syrupUSDG as a proportional pooled-credit/strategy share, denies one-to-one USDG backing and guarantees no fixed principal redemption. It is a yield-bearing strategy receipt rather than a fixed-value payment token; this explicit review follows the syrupUSDC precedent.

references.label: Maple syrupUSDG legal claim and risk disclosures

genius.notes: This is an informational payment-stablecoin scope finding, not a securities-law opinion or an authorization claim. The token name and tracked USDG parent can obscure its pooled-credit exposure. No issuer license, GENIUS approval or MiCA finding is inferred from the parent.

references.label: Maple syrupUSDG legal claim and risk disclosures
